english.title: Enter / attempt to enter / remain on Transport for London road transport premises - possess open container of alcohol
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[entered onto]_
(B)_[attempted to enter onto]_
(C)_[remained on]_

Transport for London road transport premises while you were in possession of an open container of alcohol, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ALCOHOL AND CONTAINER..)
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 4(2) and 14 of the Transport for London Road Transport Premises Byelaws made under paragraph 26 of Schedule 11 to the Greater London Authority Act 1999 and confirmed under section 67 of the Transport Act 1962.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
entered onto/attempted to enter into/remained Transport for London road transport premises
in possession of an open container of alcohol

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See Byelaw 13 for the provision of a name and address by persons suspected of breaching this byelaw.
(ii) See byelaw 15 for a power to remove persons breaching this byelaw
(iii) See byelaw 16 for the requirement for authorised persons exercising any power conferred any of the Byelaws to produce a form of identification when requested to do so.
(iv) See Byelaw 17 in relation to the provision of notices.
(V) Byelaw 4(4) provides that where an authorised person reasonably believes that any person is unfit to enter or remain on the premises or is in possession of alcohol in contravention of any provision of Byelaw 4, the authorised person may:
(a) require him to leave the premises;
(b) prevent him entering or remaining on the premises until the authorised person is satisfied that he is no longer in an unfit condition or no longer has any alcohol with him in contravention of this Byelaw 4; and (c) remove any alcohol or controlled drugs.
